description: Rijnbuurt-Oost (Plan Zuid, BAG 1934), Eemsstraat 6-36 (even side): one house in four carries a three-storey canted brick erker near the middle of its 6.1 m front (white-framed three-light glazing over brick stallrisers on storeys 1-3) on a white slab over a wide ground window, with a narrow window axis on the right over the house door at the party wall; its neighbours are the flat three-window fronts; under the row's deep flat-roof overhang

overhang.note: the row's flat-roof overhang runs over the erker top

door-right.note: the house door under the narrow axis at the right party wall

match.note: the BAG outline's erker near the middle of the front (centre 0.40-0.44) tells it from the side-erker types

rhythm.bays: a wide erker axis near the middle and a narrow window axis on the right
rhythm.symmetry: one house in four along the row, all alike
rhythm.groundFloor: a wide window under the erker slab, the house door at the right party wall
rhythm.roofline: flat roof with a deep white-fascia overhang over the erker

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2023-01-03 re-rectified with the camera 2.1 m over the ground (intake --camera-height=2.1), ruler crop of Eemsstraat 36 at 60 px/m: erker 1.33-4.08 m (2.75 m), glazing from 4.1 m on storeys 1-3, a light slab at 2.95 m over the ground window (1.4-3.9 m x 1.0-2.85 m); narrow window and the portiek doors at the right party wall; BAG outlines carry the erker at 0.40-0.44 of the front, 0.64-0.67 m deep

schemaLimits: the portiek (two doors and two side lights) straddles the BAG party wall; each house draws its own door
the window rows of the neighbouring flat fronts sit about 0.5 m off the BAG party lines (as on the strip); the types keep to the pand
notes: Palette: the type default is a mid red-brown; every placed pand takes its trim-normalised strip wall (auto-place measuredPalette).
